claims.automatic_frontier: pauseBefore suspends immediately before the first request in a supplied changed set, or at done; it retains exact captured controller, real state and ordered prefix trace.
claims.prefix_reuse: Kernels identical outside changed at every state give identical full suspended prefix laws. No Fintype Response or enumeration needed for the general construction.
claims.local_obligation: Supported suffix equalities, raw or under two observations, assemble into full game equalities. Suffix equality is an explicit obligation, not inferred merely from changed-set size.
claims.invariant: Only unchanged-request invariant preservation is required before the frontier.
claims.event_bound: One-direction event probability comparison with additive frontier reach probability; swapping the games yields the reverse comparison. No total-variation metric theorem claimed.
claims.actual_mac: Automatic input-7 frontier equals pauseAfter 3 on the original four-query target. Local decoded suffix repair is proved from actual prefix caches, then assembled; original caller and final full transcript/cache retained.
claims.diagnostic: Every execution reaches the changed verification request, so its reach probability is exactly 1 and the generic bound is vacuous here.

limits: Known ordinary monadic/game-playing principles, no higher-dimensional separation.
No proof DAG size, construction/checking-time bound or minimal repair theorem.
No claim that suffix obligations are small or automatically solved.
Common raw initial state and equality of unchanged kernels at all states are hypotheses.
No native CPU/recoding bounds, heterogeneous-box coherence or bounded primitive higher basis.
